description: Defines the UserNotificationSettings class and nested NotificationPref class for managing user notification preferences, including delivery methods and validation logic.

classes.name: UserNotificationSettings
classes.description: Main class for user notification settings, holding preferences map and delivery methods.

classes.name: UserNotificationSettings.NotificationPref
classes.description: Nested class representing individual notification preferences, including enabled status and delivery methods.

methods.name: UserNotificationSettings
methods.description: Constructor initializing preferences map from JSON property.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific notification type and delivery method are enabled based on preferences.

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Creates a default NotificationPref with all delivery methods enabled.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that only allowed delivery methods are used and their values are not null.
